worker4_repair.resolution: All linked assay/literature/entry-text rows are source-compatible with Table 2 activity values and section 3.1 TGH2 sequence evidence. The prior CAMP/dbAMP source_conflict rows were not database-only after primary-source review; they compress the E. coli ultrasound/control MIC values and are retained as source_verified with cautions.

caution_findings.finding: CAMP and dbAMP represent the E. coli ultrasound and control MIC values in a single entry-text field rather than two atomic assay rows; final activity rows keep the two primary-source Table 2 conditions separate.

The packet has zero linked_sequence_records, so sequence identity was cross-checked against merged all_sequences/five_database_sequence_catalog plus source XML section 3.1 rather than a packet-local sequence JSONL row.
